business_summary.text: Den Networks is a leading Cable TV Distribution company operating across 440+ cities in 13 states, with a wholly-owned broadband subsidiary.

penalties.details: A penalty of Rs. 28,800 was levied on the Company under Section 73 of the Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 and the Uttarakhand Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 vide order dated December 31, 2025.
penalties.impact: The financial impact of the Order is to the extent of the penalty levied. There is no impact on operations or other activities of the Company due to the Order.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Company has received an order dated February 03, 2025 ("Order") from the Joint Commissioner (ADJN), Central Tax and Central Excise, CGST Kochi Commissionerate, for recovery of differential tax amount of Rs. 33,25,97,247/- (along with applicable interest) and levying a penalty aggregating Rs. 33,25,97,247/- on the Company under Section 122(2)(b) read with Section 74(9) of the Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017, and corresponding Sections of the Kerala State Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017, for the period from July 2017 to March 2022. The Order has been passed alleging that the tax was payable by the Company on the gross amount charged by the Local Cable Operator (LCO) from the subscribers and not on the amount charged by the Company from the LCO. The Order was erroneous and the Company filed an Appeal with Commissioner (Appeals), Central Tax and Central Excise, Kochi (“Appellate Authority”) on April 15, 2025.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Joint Commissioner (ADJN), Central Tax and Central Excise, CGST Kochi Commissionerate
tax_litigation.status: The Appellate Authority, vide its order dated August 21, 2025 (received by the Company on October 29, 2025), has accepted the contention of the Company and has set aside in toto the order dated February 03, 2025 passed by the Joint Commissioner (ADJN), Central Tax and Central Excise, CGST Kochi Commissionerate and quashed the demand of Goods and Service tax, interest and penalty against the Company. The Company, vide its disclosure dated October 30, 2025, has intimated about the order of the Appellate Authority.

industry: Consumer Discretionary > Media, Entertainment & Publication > Entertainment > TV Broadcasting & Software Production

timeline.summary: Den Networks reported Q1FY27 results with flat revenue at ₹243 Cr and PAT down 5% QoQ to ₹35 Cr, while cash balances rose to ₹3,383 Cr
